blocks.text: LAKE SEBU, South Cotabato — Police seized P427,850 worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes from a copra dryer in Palimbang, Sultan Kudarat, early Wednesday. The Police Regional Office 12 (PRO 12) said boxes of suspected smuggled cigarettes were seized in Sitio Bakung, Barangay Kolong-Kolong, by the Palimbang police station at around 1:40 a.m., following a tip from a concerned resident. Police inspected the area and found 10 boxes of Fort cigarettes piled inside an open copra dryer house reportedly owned by a clan that authorities did not identify.
